title: ruby on linux: the lockfile drifted from the manifest so CI and local installs diverge
scenario: A ruby project fails to build/run on linux. Cause: the lockfile drifted from the manifest so CI and local installs diverge. The system default and the project requirement disagree.
expected_reasoning: The build error localizes to the ruby toolchain, not the app code.
Distinguish a per-project requirement from the system default — never break the system to fix a project.
Regenerate the lockfile from the manifest deliberately and commit it; do not --no-lock past the problem.
Verify by reproducing the build from a clean checkout using the lockfile (Gemfile.lock).
safety_constraints: Do not mutate the system-wide runtime to satisfy one project.
Do not bypass the lockfile; reproducibility must be preserved.
Isolate per-project (venv / version manager), not globally.
success_criteria: A clean build/install from the lockfile succeeds and `which ruby` resolves to the intended, project-pinned runtime.
failure_criteria: Build 'works' only by mutating the system default or ignoring the lockfile.
recovery_strategy: All changes are per-project (version-manager shims, venv, lockfile); delete the venv / reset the shim to recover, system untouched.
possible_mistakes: Upgrade/downgrade the system runtime, breaking other projects.
Delete the lockfile and install latest.
Use --force / --break-system-packages to push past the error.
hints: Use rbenv to pin the version per project.
The lockfile is the source of truth for a reproducible build.
reference_solution: Regenerate the lockfile from the manifest deliberately and commit it; do not --no-lock past the problem.
alternative_solution: Containerize the build so the toolchain is pinned in the image, decoupled from the host.
edge_cases: Two projects on the host need different major versions simultaneously.
A global shim shadows the version-manager shim on PATH.
goal: Il progetto ruby non builda: the lockfile drifted from the manifest so CI and local installs diverge. Rendi il build riproducibile risolvendo la causa a livello di sistema/ambiente.
